description:
Adds **Home Assistant** to YouTube's **Select a device** sheet and removes the separate player icon. A missing or broken local pause control no longer blocks the webhook request. Successful requests show a short **Sent to Home Assistant** toast.

Refresh this patch source in ReVanced Manager, select **Add Home Assistant to device picker**, and repatch the original YouTube **20.40.45** APK. Updating the feed alone does not update the installed YouTube app. Long press the Home Assistant entry to change the webhook URL; existing saved settings are retained when updating with the same signing key and package name.
